correctness.rationale: A state is recurrent exactly when all internal rotors strictly left of the walker point right and strictly right point left; periodicity follows an Eulerian edge tour and necessity from last departures. Starting at endpoint 0, initially right-pointing sites i_1<...<i_r cause complete 2i_j out-and-back excursions for j<r and a final i_r steps to first root-consistent state, giving 2Σi−max S. Condition on max k yields polynomial. By monotonicity of ordered positions, the extremal size-r subsets are {1..r} and {m−r+1..m}, attaining r² and (2r−1)m−r(r−1); maximum m² unique all right. For independent fair Bernoulli B_i, τ=2ΣiB_i−M, E M=m−1+2^(−m), so mean (m²−m+2)/2−2^(−m). Lindeberg weighted Bernoulli CLT and bounded M/m^(3/2) correction give N(0,1/3). Independently reproduced full graph periodic-state extraction and all endpoint configurations n=3..11, not used as all-n proof.
